name: regex_namespace_anchors
reason: The selected regex policy honors all anchors. Go helpers bypass assertions when using a completed literal prefix; Rust applies the complete expression, matching the predicate.

name: match_data_nested_mutation
reason: Match-data protection applies through nested write paths. A copied capture array may be modified independently; a write through the protected result is rejected.

name: match_data_duplicate_mutation
reason: Duplicating match data preserves its protection. Go deep cloning drops the tag and permits the resulting object to be cleared.

name: match_data_duplicate_rendering
reason: Duplicating match data preserves its published string rendering. Go deep cloning drops that rendering together with the protected tag.

name: substitution_word_boundaries
reason: Global substitution retains the original assertion context. Go's suffix-window repair can skip valid word-boundary and non-boundary matches; Rust evaluates every eligible character boundary.

name: substitution_match_data_rendering
reason: Match data retains its published whole-match rendering when a replacement block returns it. Go's bounded conversion loses the specialized rendering and emits an object placeholder.

name: class_index_getter_snapshot
source:
class Grid
def initialize;@slots={};end
def [](row,col);@slots.fetch("#{row}:#{col}",nil);end
def []=(row,col,value);@slots["#{row}:#{col}"]=value;"ignored";end
end
def run(input)
grid=Grid.new;grid[0,0]=[1];saved=grid[0,0];grid[0,0][0]=8;[saved,grid[0,0]]
end
